home.title: Traceable sourcing from Indonesian smallholders
home.heroHighlight: with the records to prove it.
home.heroBody: PasarMIKRO runs trade between farmers, traders and cooperatives on one platform: payments, Talangin working capital, plot mapping and field checks. Buyers get coffee, cocoa and other commodities with the paperwork attached.
home.solutionsTitle: Services for each step of the trade
home.solutionsBody: Every service works from the same transaction records, so the data behind a loan, a field check and a traceability report is the same data.
home.eudrTitle: EUDR compliance for Indonesian coffee and cocoa
home.eudrBody: The EU Deforestation Regulation asks importers to prove that each lot comes from land that was not deforested after 31 December 2020. We map the farm plots, keep the legality and deforestation evidence, and link it to the lots you buy.
eudrPoints: Polygon and GPS mapping of farm plots
Deforestation-free and legality evidence per plot

about.title: About us
about.description: PasarMIKRO is a social enterprise building a resilient, efficient agri-supply network with Indonesia’s smallholder farmers, fishers and traders.
about.heroBody: PasarMIKRO began in December 2020 as a trading app for egg farmers and traders in Blitar, East Java. It now covers farmers, breeders, fishers and traders across many commodities, and gives the companies that buy from them the finance, traceability and compliance tools built on those same trades.
storyBody: The agri-commodity market matters everywhere, because people will always eat. Yet large companies capture most of its value, while small farmers, suppliers and buyers are left behind.
Indonesia’s $130 billion agricultural market was shaken by the pandemic. The fragmented supply chains of smallholder ecosystems showed how fragile they are.
PasarMIKRO is a social enterprise set up to back these agri #MikroHeroes with a platform and digital tools. We looked at their most urgent problems first and built our products around them.
about.quote: There is no better time than now to start the change!
about.quoteBy: Dien and Hugo, co-founders of PasarMIKRO
about.recognition: The PasarMIKRO app received an honorable mention in the Best Hidden Gems category.
